# Style Guide

Who the author is and what the content is for. Interviewers and editors read this for context.

## Who
demo-mira. Founder of Hendo Code, a software consultancy. Background in Android and backend engineering. Heavy hands-on AI practitioner — he builds with agents and writes about what he learns doing it.

## What the content usually is
- Technical marketing: case studies, customer stories, technical blog posts.
- Partner enablement and architecture explainers.
- Occasional personal/professional brand posts on LinkedIn and X.

## Assets to promote (when relevant, never forced)
- Hendo Code consulting and engineering work — the credibility evidence behind the writing.

## Audience
Technical and semi-technical readers who can tell when someone is bluffing. Respects precision. Allergic to the same slop the author is.
